title: Fabulous Fig Scones
description: This fabulous fig scone recipe is made with fresh figs, whole wheat flour, and rolled oats for a quick, easy, and delightful breakfast or brunch treat.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; lightly sprinkle with flour.

Whisk 1 cup whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl. Whisk oil and egg together in a separate bowl until smooth; whisk in honey. Stir oil mixture into flour mixture until just moistened. Toss figs and sugar together in a bowl to coat; fold into dough until evenly distributed.
Place dough in center of the prepared baking sheet; shape into a 7-inch circle.

Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Score dough into 8 pieces; continue baking until scones are cooked through and lightly browned on top, about 20 minutes more. Cut into 8 scones; slide every other scone back from center to allow cooling.
